messages:
Olivia Chen: Quick announcement — G540 micro-pools are live in cpt1 (Cape Town) as of ~10:00 UTC. Rolling out 8 micro-pools (g540) for Dedicated and Reserved customers. Docs + reservation guidance: https://redwood.ai/docs/g540-cpt-launch :tada:

Matt L: Awesome — does this include reserved commit support or just burst capacity initially?

Olivia Chen: Initial launch supports both: burst + reserved commits. Reserved slots will be provisioned tomorrow 09:00 UTC. If you need early allocations, DM me or file a reservations request in the console.

Matt L: Perfect. Any CLI for reservations?

Olivia Chen: Yep — example: `ri reservations create --region cpt1 --gpu g540 --count 4 --commit 30d --priority reserved`

Sana R: Ops note: these nodes are running driver 55.3.1, CUDA 12.4, mixed ECC config. Telemetry tag is `g540-cpt-v1`. We'll be monitoring temp/fan telemetry closely during first 48h. If you see >5% failed allocations ping #eng-oncall.

Dinesh K: Heads-up to product/marketing: update pricing page and console GPU list to include G540 label + recommended quant profiles. Also slight policy tweak: free-tier burst windows for micro-pools are capped at 20m per-day for cpt1 during the warm-up period (to protect latency SLOs).

Matt L: Noted on the 20m cap — can we surface that in the reservation flow UI?

Olivia Chen: Yes — console will show a small banner and tooltip explaining the temporary 20m cap and rationale. We'll remove the cap if utilization stays healthy for 7 days.

deploy-bot: [system] Created pools: pool-cpt-g540-01..08. Health checks started. Expected fully healthy in ~2h. Any pool failing >3 consecutive checks will trigger a rollback event and notify #eng-oncall.

Sana R: For teams running large chat models: recommend pinning KV cache policy to `aggressive` and preferring quant profile `q4_opt` for lower mem footprint. We'll publish recommended runtime configs in the doc.

Dinesh K: Logistics: internal launch email to customers will go out at 14:00 UTC with reservation links + FAQ. Please flag any blockers by 12:30 UTC.

Matt L: Thanks! leaning in to update infra tests to include g540 smoke tests.

Olivia Chen: Thanks all — if you see anything odd, @Olivia or #eng-oncall. :loud_sound:
